name: SatNOGS DB API
summary: Crowdsourced database of satellites, their radio transmitters, modes and TLEs, openly licensed and free to read without a key.
description: SatNOGS DB lists satellites and other orbital objects with status, launch and decay dates, operator and countries, plus transmitters (frequencies, modes, baud) and recent TLEs. It is aimed at amateur-radio and ground-station use; telemetry and artifact endpoints need an authentication token.

auth.notes: Satellites, transmitters, modes and tle are public. telemetry and artifacts returned 401 without a token.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages I fetched.

endpoints.summary: Satellites and objects with status, launch date, operator
Radio transmitters with frequencies, modes and baud

agent_notes: Filter by norad_cat_id for a single object; the unfiltered satellites list returns thousands of rows in one response. sat_id is SatNOGS's own stable id. Frequencies are in Hz.
caveats: telemetry and artifacts endpoints require authentication (401 seen).
Rate limits are not documented in what I fetched; Django REST throttling may apply.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key; transmitters, tle and modes also answered 200.
